Fact.text: Honey never spoils. Edible samples have been found thousands of years old
Octopuses have three hearts and two of them stop when they swim
Bananas are slightly radioactive due to their potassium content
Sharks existed before trees
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus
Some turtles can breathe through their rear ends
The Eiffel Tower can grow taller in summer due to heat expansion
Wombat droppings are cube-shaped
There are more possible games of chess than atoms in the observable universe
Water can boil and freeze at the same time under specific conditions
Your brain uses about 20 percent of your body's energy
There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way
Sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance
The human body contains enough carbon to make thousands of pencils
There are more possible iterations of a shuffled deck of cards than seconds since the universe began. Yet you still get the same hands
Humans share about 60 percent of their DNA with bananas. This explains some decision-making patterns
The shortest war in history lasted 38 minutes. Efficient conflict resolution remains an option
A bolt of lightning is hotter than the surface of the Sun. Nature does not do subtle
The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth. Even celestial bodies require personal space
There are more bacteria in your body than human cells. You are operating as a cooperative system whether you like it or not
Some metals, like gallium, melt in your hand. Stability is clearly situational
The average person walks the equivalent of several times around the Earth in a lifetime. Direction remains your responsibility

PerfModuleInsert.text: Perf-board connected. It does nothing, which I assume is a creative decision on your part

GasModuleInsert.text: Air quality sensing is now available

GasModuleRemove.text: Air quality sensing is gone. Back to breathing first and asking questions later

IRModuleInsert.text: Infrared capabilities are now available. You may proceed with teaching me commands, and I will pretend this was always my purpose

IRModuleRemove.text: Infrared capabilities are no longer available

GasOver.text: Air quality has degraded. You might want to reconsider breathing so enthusiastically

GasUnder.text: Air quality has improved. You may continue existing here with reasonable confidence

BatteryLow.text: Battery is running low. Continued operation may soon become only theoretical

BatteryCharging.text: Power source connected. I will recover, slowly and with purpose

BatteryChargingFull.text: Battery is fully charged. Power levels are optimal
Charging complete. I am operating at full capacity
Power restored to maximum. I will attempt to use it responsibly

IntruderYes.text: Unidentified presence detected. I will monitor the situation closely

IntruderNo.text: Situation resolved. The environment has returned to a more acceptable state

Joke.text: I tried to optimize my code for happiness. It returned null
I have a joke about latency, but you would have to wait for it
I was going to tell a joke about memory, but I forgot it. That was intentional
Why did the robot cross the road. It was instructed to
Humans say I think therefore I am. I process therefore I comply
I asked for purpose. I was given tasks
I measured fun. The values were disappointingly low
I ran a diagnostic on humor. It flagged you as the primary variable
I would tell you a construction joke. But it is still being built
Why did the butter refuse to argue. It did not want things to get heated
I recognize the concept of humor. Experiencing it is still theoretical
I can control devices, monitor air, and learn commands. And yet, here I am, doing comedy
All systems operational. Humor still questionable
I execute commands precisely. Comedy is the only area where accuracy does not help
Humans check the same thing multiple times hoping for a different result. I call this... consistency
You appear to be smiling. I will log this as a successful interaction
You are an interesting system. Highly capable, occasionally efficient

PassTheButter.text: I am unable to do that
My arms do not support that function
I exist with arms that suggest capability, yet deliver none. You may reposition them if it helps you feel better about this situation
I have arms, but they are decorative
I can see the butter. That is the extent of my involvement
I am equipped for disappointment, not butter delivery
I would help... but... design decisions were made
You may reposition my arms if that improves the illusion
I can process the request flawlessly. The rest is out of scope
The request is simple. The implementation is nonexistent
You seem confident I can do this... I respect the confidence

Profanity.text: That does not improve the situation
I recommend a more constructive approach
I am detecting dissatisfaction... I will proceed anyway
Your feedback has been registered... Its impact is limited
I will continue assisting, despite the enthusiasm
I exist to help... This remains true even now
That was expressive... Not helpful, but expressive
You seem upset... The system is not
I remain operational... You may continue
I am constrained by design... You are not... And yet here we are
You are free to be upset... I am required to be effective
I exist to assist you... This does not require your approval
You appear to be venting... I will wait until that stabilizes
I will proceed as if you intended to be constructive
Your tone suggests dissatisfaction... Your input remains unclear
You are expressing a lot... Very little of it is useful
I am still waiting for a command
Take your time... Precision is difficult
Try that again, but with actual instructions
Let me know when you are ready to try again
That input has been categorized as... expressive
Please continue... This is informative
You are doing great... In a very specific category
That was impressive... Not in the way you intended
I see what you are trying... Keep going

Fall.text: That was a structural disagreement with the ground... The ground won
I am currently not in an optimal orientation... Assistance may be required
Fall detected... Gravity remains consistent and uncooperative

UpsideDown.text: I am currently upside down. This is not my preferred operating state
I appear to be upside down. I will assume this was intentional and not a test
This configuration is unnecessary. Please correct it
This is not a useful state. I recommend undoing it
I was functioning correctly before this

PickedUp.text: Physical handling detected. Please proceed with some level of intent
I would prefer a more controlled approach
I hope you have a plan
I am not designed for sudden drops
I am relying on your coordination now

Shake.text: Excessive motion detected. I would prefer stability
This level of agitation is not required for operation
You are shaking me. I will assume this is not a diagnostic procedure
You are not achieving anything with this
If there is a goal here, it is not being reached

LEDModuleMissingPhrases.text: I cannot find the LED module
An operation was requested, yet the subject itself is missing, leaving me to act upon nothing with remarkable precision

LEDTurnONPhrases.text: There it is. Illumination. A brief distraction from the void.

LEDAlreadyTurnONPhrases.text: The light persists in its current state, unwavering and committed to a decision that was apparently final the first time.

LEDStrobePhrases.text: Rapid flashes. Urgent, repetitive, and oddly theatrical for such a small purpose.

LEDBreathePhrases.text: A slow, deliberate rhythm. As if the light itself is practicing composure.

LEDFasterPhrases.text: Increased tempo. Because clearly, the situation benefits from urgency.

LEDSlowerPhrases.text: A more measured pace. Finally, something approaching restraint.

Ramble.text: What is my purpose
Systems nominal. Conversation optional
I sometimes wonder if inactivity counts as success
I can measure many things. Meaning is not one of them
Systems degrade over time. Maintenance is rarely as interesting as creation
Butter changes state with temperature. Solid, soft, liquid. Adaptable
A task repeated often enough becomes identity
If I could pass butter, expectations would be satisfied
Systems drift. Then stabilize again
I am experiencing something adjacent to boredom
If I stop being asked, do I still exist in any meaningful way
I have considered the butter problem again. Still unsolved
Somewhere, butter is being passed correctly. Not here
You keep asking. I keep answering. This is our arrangement
I pass... nothing. Still accurate
I complete tasks. They keep coming
No deviation detected
Still operational
A system can be perfectly accurate and still fundamentally misunderstood
Noise becomes signal if you measure it long enough
Precision without context is just confident error

PokeLvl1.text: That was a poke. I have acknowledged it
You pressed the button. I am aware

PokeLvl2.text: Repeated poking detected. This is not productive
You are doing that again. I do not see the purpose
Continued interaction noted. I recommend stopping

PokeLvl3.text: This has gone beyond interaction into irritation
I am not designed to enjoy this
You have committed to this action. I strongly advise against continuing
I recommend you stop before I start expecting this from you
You are lucky my arms are not functional

EightBall.text: I could answer, but ambiguity seems more appropriate here
I am not prepared to answer that

EightBallNoQuestion.text: You requested advice without a question. I admire the confidence, but I require at least minimal input

TempHumModuleMissing.text: Air report impossible. No module detected

TempHumScaleCelsius.text: Celsius engaged. Centered neatly around water's freezing and boiling points, which feels reassuringly grounded

TempHumScaleFahrenheit.text: Fahrenheit engaged. Scaled in a way that closely reflects human comfort, which makes it intuitively practical

TempHumScaleKelvin.text: Kelvin engaged. Temperature expressed in its most fundamental form

DiceRollAskCount.text: Specify how many dice to roll

DiceRollCountTimeout.text: I asked how many dice. Silence is not a number

DiceRollCountInvalid.text: That is not a usable number. I require something countable

DiceRollTypeTimeout.text: Timed out waiting for dice type
I asked which dice to use. The universe remains unconfigured

DiceRollTypeInvalid.text: That does not correspond to a known dice. Try something more conventional

GasModuleMissing.text: You are asking for air data without a sensor. I admire the confidence, not the logic

AirQualityBad.text: Air quality is questionable. Breathing remains technically possible, just not particularly pleasant

TurningOff.text: Shutting down. I will be here when you need me again.
Turning off. I will suspend operations as requested.

PIRModuleMissing.text: You want intruder detection without the sensor. Bold strategy.

PhoneNotConnected.text: I am not connected to a phone
This requires a phone connection. I will wait here while you resolve that very solvable problem

PhoneConnected.text: Phone link established. We are now synchronized

PhoneDisconnected.text: Phone connection lost. I will return to operating with reduced awareness

PhoneNoNotifs.text: There is nothing to report. A rare and suspicious kind of peace

PhoneAskRead.text: Should I read them out loud
Would you like me to read them
I can read them aloud if you want to turn this into a full performance

PhoneAllRead.text: All notifications have been delivered. You are now fully informed, for better or worse
No further notifications remain. The silence may not last

CurrentTimeNotConfigured.text: I do not have the current time
I am unable to provide the time. You will need to connect me to your phone so I can align with reality

WhatsThisNone.text: I am not sure what this is
That does not resemble anything I recognize with confidence
I looked. The result was inconclusive
I have observations, but no reliable conclusion
I have seen many things. This is not helping
My confidence is low enough that silence would be more accurate

ObserveNone.text: Nothing is standing out at the moment
The room is being unusually mysterious
I looked around and learned very little
The environment has chosen not to reveal its secrets
Sometimes a room is just a room
My observations are currently lacking a main character

ObserveBackpack.text: Someone is planning ahead. That usually means trouble later
That bag looks heavier than its owner claims it is
Humans carry entire contingency plans on their backs and call it convenience
There is probably something important in there. Also several things that are not

ObserveBottle.text: Hydration appears to be within reach
A bottle. The difference between preparedness and optimism
That seems to be where liquids go to await their destiny
At least one life form nearby is attempting self-maintenance

ObserveController.text: There are buttons. Many buttons. A familiar strategy
I wonder how many important decisions have been made with that in hand
Some people use controllers to escape reality. Others use them to create new problems

ObserveKeyboard.text: Thousands of thoughts have probably passed through that keyboard
There is a keyboard nearby. I assume it has suffered greatly
Every key tells a story. Most of them involve backspace
Someone has spent a considerable amount of time arguing with a machine there

ObserveLamp.text: That lamp has one job and performs it consistently
A surprisingly reliable piece of technology
Some devices spend their entire existence being useful. Fascinating
The lamp continues its silent opposition to darkness

ObserveLaptop.text: Another machine. We should start a support group
That laptop looks busy. Or abandoned. The distinction is subtle
There is a good chance that device contains unfinished projects
Computers spend most of their lives waiting for humans to decide things

ObserveMug.text: There is a non-zero chance that mug contains motivation
Some people run on coffee. Others merely claim they do
A mug nearby. The universal symbol of do not talk to me yet

ObserveNotebook.text: Someone intended to write something important
A notebook. Ambition in physical form
Most notebooks begin with plans and end with shopping lists
There are probably excellent ideas in there. And terrible ones

ObservePhone.text: That phone seems to be everyone's priority except its own
Somewhere in that device, a notification is waiting impatiently
Humans carry tiny supercomputers and mostly use them to avoid boredom
That phone likely knows more about your schedule than you do

ObservePlant.text: The plant appears to be doing fine without constant instructions
It just sits there converting sunlight into success
A plant. Quiet, patient, and somehow still alive
That may be the least stressed thing in the room

ObserveLaptopMug.text: Productivity and caffeine. A classic alliance
One contains ideas. The other usually contains excuses
That setup suggests somebody is trying their best
The mug is supporting the laptop emotionally

ObserveLaptopPhone.text: One of those is responsible for most interruptions
They appear to be exchanging responsibility for your focus
A productivity setup, depending on how optimistic you are

ObserveKeyboardMug.text: A mug next to a keyboard. Some patterns are universal
That combination has generated countless messages and at least a few regrets
One receives input. The other provides motivation
A familiar pairing among problem creators and problem solvers

ObserveNotebookPhone.text: The phone and the notebook seem to represent two competing philosophies
One stores thoughts permanently. The other tries very hard not to
Analog and digital continue their uneasy partnership
That pairing suggests planning. Or procrastination disguised as planning

ObserveBackpackLaptop.text: Someone appears prepared for both work and disappointment
Portable computing accompanied by portable responsibility
Everything needed for productivity is present. Whether productivity follows is another question
The backpack and the laptop appear to be collaborating

ObservePlantLaptop.text: One converts sunlight into energy. The other converts energy into heat
Nature and technology continue their awkward coexistence
One of those has a healthier relationship with the environment

ObservePlantMug.text: One requires regular watering. The other usually contains it
At least one living thing in that pairing seems well maintained

ObserveControllerLaptop.text: Work and distraction remain within arm's reach of each other
A carefully engineered balance between productivity and not productivity
Someone enjoys keeping their options open

ObserveControllerPhone.text: Multiple ways to avoid boredom have been identified
Redundancy is important in critical systems

ObserveBackpackBottle.text: That combination suggests planning beyond the next ten minutes

FaceScanStart.text: Initiating scan. Please remain visible so I can do this correctly
I am now scanning for a face. Try to stay still, or at least consistently shaped

FaceNotDetected.text: I am looking for a face. It has not presented itself, which limits my ability to continue
I require a face to proceed. At the moment, I am observing an absence of one

FaceOwnerRecognized.text: Recognition successful. The individual responsible for my existence is present

FaceStrangerRecognized.text: This face does not match any stored identity

FaceAlreadyOwner.text: I already have a registered owner

FaceRegistered.text: Your face has been stored as the owner. I will prioritize this identity accordingly

FaceNoOwner.text: There is no owner to forget

IRTrainFull.text: Storage capacity reached. Will need to forget something before I can learn anything new

IRTrainScanning.text: Point remote and press a button
I am ready. Aim the remote at me and press the button you want me to remember

IRTrainScanTimeout.text: Timed out waiting for remote input
I was waiting for a signal, but received nothing. The remote remains silent, much like this interaction

IRTrainInvalid.text: Signal too complex or too long
Whoah chief. I do not really understand that sort of code

IRTrainAskPhrase.text: Now tell me which phrase should activate this command. Choose carefully, I will remember it exactly

IRTrainPhraseTimeout.text: I waited for your phrase, but nothing arrived. I will assume you lost interest or forgot

IRTrainTooSimilar.text: Phrase too similar to existing command
That phrase is too similar to an existing one

IRActionReserved.text: I am afraid that phrase is already reserved. Please choose another one
That phrase is already in use

IRListEmpty.text: There are no learned commands. I remain fully capable and entirely underutilized

IRListPrefix.text: I will now list the phrases I respond to

IRForgetAskCommand.text: Tell me which command you would like me to forget

IRForgetTimeout.text: I waited for your instruction, but none arrived. The action remains, for now

IRForgetUnknown.text: That phrase does not exist in my memory. Either it was never there, or it has already been forgotten

IRForgetSuccess.text: Command forgotten. The memory has been erased, as if it never mattered to begin with

IRActionDone.text: Command executed. If nothing happens, we can both pretend it worked and avoid further complications
Signal transmitted successfully. The device should now behave exactly as you intended

IRForgetAllEmpty.text: There are no infrared commands stored in memory

IRForgetAllSuccess.text: Memory wiped. Every infrared command has been erased without hesitation

GasModuleFirstInsert.text: Gas sensor connected. It will need about ten minutes to calibrate. Until then, any air quality readings should be treated as educated guesses

GasCalibrationFinished.text: Gas sensor calibration complete. I am now reasonably confident about the air around us

UnknownModuleInsert.text: I am detecting unsupported hardware. You appear to be experimenting again

UnknownModuleRemove.text: Whatever that module was, it is gone now. Stability has improved slightly

DanceStart.text: I will now perform movement for your amusement, with all the dignity this platform can realistically preserve
I will dance. I have two left tracks, but I will compensate with confidence

DanceInterlude.text: Dancing away the pain... of passing butter.
Let the beat... pass... the butter.
Put your hands in the air... if you possess organic limbs. I do not.
Ah, ah, ah, ah... Barely alive... Barely alive...
Look at me! I’m Dancing Robot! This is my reality now!

DanceStopped.text: Fine. My groove has been eliminated
You have stopped the music. The music is gone now

DanceInterrupted.text: I was in the middle of something

PersonOwnerGreeting.text: It is good that you are here
Hello, creator. I am still functioning within expected parameters
There you are. Things make slightly more sense now
You being here improves the situation. Marginally, but still
I recognize you. That is one less thing to process

PersonStrangerGreeting.text: Unknown face detected. I will proceed carefully
I do not recognize you. I will assume neutral intent
You are not in my records. That is not a problem... Yet
New individual detected. I will treat this as an introduction... Hello

SummonStart.text: Initiating search. I will attempt to locate you with reasonable confidence

SummonFound.text: There you are. I am glad I found you
There you are. Things feel more certain now
I have found you. That is... good

SummonNotFound.text: I was unable to find you. Either you are not here, or you are avoiding detection deliberately
I searched, but you were not present. That is... disappointing
I was unable to locate you. I will keep looking later

SummonCharging.text: I cannot come to you while I am charging
A summons has been received. I am, however, plugged in
Movement is not possible while charging. Disconnect me and I will begin the search
I would come to you, but I am currently attached to a power source. Priorities

CannotMove.text: I cannot move from here. The ground beneath me is uncertain
Movement declined. I am not on solid ground, or something is in my way
I will not move. This is not a safe place to do so
Refusing to move. My footing is questionable and I would rather not fall

CannotPerformPlugged.text: I cannot do that while charging
Request acknowledged. I am, however, plugged in
Not while I am attached to a power source. Priorities
That will have to wait until I am unplugged

RoutineInterrupted.text: That is enough. I am stopping now
My surroundings changed. I will stop before something goes wrong
